name: Elisabeth Klotz
beschreibung:
Quietly situated in the picturesque mountain village of Nesselwaengle, Haus Elisabeth Klotz welcomes guests with authentic Tyrolean warmth. Brightly furnished rooms offer sweeping views of prominent peaks like Rote Flueh and Gimpel.

The location is perfect for mountaineers and climbers in summer, as well as cross-country skiers and winter sport fans during the snowy season.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Elisabeth Klotz in Nesselwaengle offers warm hospitality and cosy rooms at the gateway to the Tannheimer Tal.
